title: KAPPA: Checking the Proofs in Statistics Papers with Lean 4 and Language Model Agents
title_zh: KAPPA：用Lean 4与语言模型智能体检查统计学论文中的证明

paragraphs.en: KAPAA套件用LLM智能体将统计学论文证明翻译到Lean 4检查，并成功发现已发表论文中的错误。 Papers in statistical theory rest on long proofs that few readers check line by line. We present KAPPA (Kit of Agents for Proof-checking Papers with a proof Assistant), open-source software that organizes language model agents, run by Claude Code, to translate the proofs of a LaTeX paper into the proof assistant Lean 4 with its library Mathlib and check them there, result by result. Each numbered result receives one of four verdicts: verified unconditionally; verified conditionally, with every cited or unproved input stated as a named hypothesis; issue recorded, with its place in the paper and the side at fault; or unfinished, with the reason. The kit follows the paper's own proof step by step, rather than finding a new one. Separate agents write and review, each statement is compared with the paper before it is proved and fingerprinted afterwards, and every verdict rests on evidence that can be rerun without a language model. The kit runs unattended for hours, waits out usage limits, re-checks only what a revision changed and reports its cost by role, model and result. We describe the design, walk through a complete run, and apply the kit to four example papers with answer keys and to three published statistical papers, checked blind in their versions from before public corrections. In all three, the kit found the published error at the step that the correction names, together with further problems that we confirmed by hand. Given the same papers directly, the same language model working with Lean classified fewer results correctly on the longest paper and reported some statements narrower than the paper's as proved; no verdict of the kit claimed more than its Lean evidence showed.
paragraphs.zh: KAPAA套件用LLM智能体将统计学论文证明翻译到Lean 4检查，并成功发现已发表论文中的错误。统计理论领域的论文依赖于冗长的证明，几乎没有读者会逐行核对。 我们提出KAPPA（Kit of Agents for Proof-checking Papers with a proof Assistant，用于配合证明助手审校论文证明的智能体套件），这是一套开源软件，负责组织由Claude Code运行的语言模型智能体，将一篇LaTeX论文的证明翻译到证明助手Lean 4及其库Mathlib中，并在那里逐条结果地进行检查。 每条编号结果会得到四种判定之一：无条件通过验证；有条件通过验证，其中所有引用或未经证明的前提均以命名假设的形式陈述；记录问题，并注明其在论文中的位置及出错一方；或未完成，并说明原因。 该套件逐行遵循论文自身的证明，而不是寻找新的证明。 写作与审校由不同的智能体分别完成；每条命题在证明之前都与论文进行比对，证明之后再进行指纹记录；每一项判定都以无需语言模型即可复现的证据为依据。 该套件可以无人值守地运行数小时，等待使用限额恢复，只重新检查修订所改动的部分，并按角色、模型和结果汇报其成本。 我们描述该套件的设计，完整展示一次运行过程，并将该套件应用于四篇带有标准答案的示例论文，以及三篇已发表的统计学论文——这些论文在其公开勘误之前的版本上进行了盲检。 在这三篇论文中，该套件都在勘误所指出的步骤上发现了已发表的错误，此外还发现了我们经人工核实属实的其他问题。 如果直接向同一个语言模型提供同样的论文而不借助本套件，该模型配合Lean在最长的那篇论文上正确分类的结果更少，并且把论文中某些范围更窄的命题报告为已证明；而本套件的任何判定都没有超出其Lean证据所显示的范围。
